name: instagram-saas
description: Instagram automation SaaS. Two independent applications: a Next.js frontend and a Node/Express backend, talking over REST.

scripts.//: This root package intentionally declares no workspaces. frontend/ and backend/ each own their dependencies and can be installed, built, and deployed on their own; these scripts are a convenience for running both locally, not a coupling.
scripts.//install: `cd`, not `npm --prefix`. With --prefix, npm still resolves lifecycle scripts against the ROOT package.json, so this postinstall re-fires and recurses until the process dies. `cd` changes the working directory for real, so each child npm reads its own manifest — which has no postinstall.
scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently --names "backend,frontend" --prefix-colors "blue,magenta" --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.start: concurrently --names "backend,frontend" "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
